exposes.name: relay_left_physical_mode
exposes.label: Physical relay behavior
exposes.description: Controls the electrical mains relay independently of the logical Zigbee On/Off state. Follow state immediately synchronizes mains to the logical state. Always on keeps the load energized and is recommended for smart bulbs/dimmers. Always off keeps mains de-energized while logical state can still change. Changing this setting can immediately switch mains power. The setting persists across restart.
